messages.content: Which error code is specified to be skipped by the slave using slave_skip_errors?
Which error code is set to be skipped by the slave?
Error code 1062 is set to be skipped by the slave.
在用户端B导入任务时，什么情况下会导致导入失败？
如果导入的任务指定的用户端不包含用户端B，则导入任务失败。
What are the dust and water proofing ratings and their specific test conditions?
The device has IEC60529-IP67 rating (tested at 1m depth for 0.5 hours) and IEC60529-IP66 rating.
公文下载任务在网络故障或关机中断后如何处理？
如遇网络故障或关机时，未完成下载的任务停止下载，网络恢复正常或开机后，重新自动下载。
当对讲机处于直通模式导致网络注册失败或找不到网络时，应如何处理？
应切换至集群模式。
公文下载任务在网络故障或关机中断后如何恢复？
网络恢复正常或开机后，未完成下载的任务将重新自动下载。
当对讲机出现按键、显示屏或指示灯异常时，应如何排查和处理？
若为暂时失灵，可关机后开机重试；若确认为损坏，需联系当地经销商或我司技术支持人员维修。
对讲机出现噪声较大或无法定位故障，且原因是所处位置不佳（如受高大建筑物阻挡或位于地下室）时，应采取什么措施？
移至开阔平坦地后重试。
当终端遇到被ROOT等异常时，如何进行自我处理？
终端侧可调用内置围栏策略进行自我处理。
Under which part of the FCC Rules was this equipment tested for compliance as a Class B digital device?
The equipment was tested and found to comply with the limits for a Class B digital device pursuant to part 15 of FCC Rules.
How many latest messages are displayed on the homepage?
20 latest messages are displayed.
Under what conditions are offline diagnosis logs available?
Offline logs are available if the function is enabled via programming or OTAP.
若经销商无防水测试条件但用户需要等同原机的防护级别，应如何处理？
请寄回我司维修或请我司协调就近授权维修站处理。
为避免影响发射功率，测试应在什么供电电压下进行？
CAT1 模块校准测试需要检测哪部分链路？
校准测试检测模块至射频座链路即可。
进行综合测试时，推荐使用的综合测试仪型号有哪些？
Aeroflex 3920 和 HP8921。
如何连接设备并启动终端发射进行测试？
首先连接终端的天线端口与 HP8921 的 RF 端口，将 HP8921 设置为发射测试模式，并通过附件音频调试线连接终端、PC 和 HP8921。然后在 SSCOM 软件中依次单击“连接”、“进入调测”、“选择信道”，最后单击调测界面上的“发射”以启动终端发射。
如何连接终端、PC 和 HP8921 以进行接收测试？
连接终端的天线端口与 HP8921 的 RF 端口，并将 HP8921 设置为接收测试模式。通过附件音频调试线连接终端、PC 和 HP8921。
如何避免 slave 端因复制错误而中断？
可以通过跳过主从复制中遇到的所有错误或指定类型的错误，来避免 slave 端复制中断。
主从复制中 1062 和 1032 错误分别代表什么原因？
1062 错误是指一些主键重复，1032 错误是因为主从数据库数据不一致。
What error message is displayed when MDMUserClient.exe fails to initialize due to a missing .NET Framework?
.NET Framework Initialization Error
Under which FCC rules was this equipment tested for compliance as a Class B digital device?
Part 15 of FCC Rules.
What steps are required to calibrate and enable normal use of the Compass app?
When using the compass for the first time, calibrate it according to the on-screen instructions. To normally use the compass, allow it to access your location information.
How should you troubleshoot a radio that fails to respond to any operation?
If the radio fails to respond to any operation, it may be due to too many apps running. The solution is to forcibly stop some apps or restart the radio.
当客户终端在使用过程中出现故障时，技术支持人员可以采取哪些方式协助解决？
技术支持人员可以到现场帮助解决，或推送Quick Log给用户自行安装并抓取Log和Trace。
用户通过Quick Log抓取Log和Trace后，应如何处理这些文件以分析故障原因？
抓取后将文件发送给客服或研发人员分析故障原因。
What is the latest version for the PDC760 multimodal smart terminal?
The latest versions for the PDC760 are V3.5.001101, V3.5.0011G1, V3.5.001102, and V3.5.0011G2.
系统如何通过WIFI/LTE网络实现对讲机的远程诊断与控制？
系统可通过WIFI/LTE网络搜集对讲机硬件指标和运行参数进行分析诊断，监控是否被入侵或存在非法程序；同时可实时远程控制，关闭目标对讲机的BT、GPS、相机、WLAN等功能，并配置部分参数。
对讲机的短扫描、全面扫描和段扫描模式在登记失败时的处理逻辑有何不同？
短扫描：先扫描最近登记成功的信道，若失败则依次扫描邻近基站信道和固定控制信道列表中的信道。全面扫描：先执行短扫描，若失败则从系统指定的信道依次扫描，每扫描一定数量信道就执行一次短扫描。段扫描：先扫描最近登记成功的信道，若失败则依次扫描邻近基站信道和固定控制信道列表中的段扫描信道，仅对可用基站扫描。
公文下载过程中遇到网络故障或关机时会发生什么？
未完成下载的任务停止下载，网络恢复正常或开机后，重新自动下载。
What new features or support additions distinguish Smart MDM V1.6.07.000 from V1.5.11.000 regarding PDC760 and diagnostics?
Comparing to V1.5.11.000, this version supports PDC760 V1B1 and PDC760 UxB2, and has added the radio diagnosis log for failure analysis.
What is the primary purpose of the conformance testing specification defined in ETSI EN 300 394-1?
The purpose is to provide a sufficient quality of radio transmission and reception for equipment operating in a TETRA system and to minimize harmful interference to other equipment.
What are the four error control stages applied to control signalling logical channels such as BSCH, SCH/HD, and SCH-P8/HD?
The four stages are: Stage 1 uses block code plus 4 tail bits; Stage 2 uses RCPC code with a rate of 2/3; Stage 3 uses a block interleaver; and Stage 4 uses scrambling.
How does the error control scheme for the AACH logical channel differ from other control signalling channels regarding stages 2 and 3?
For the AACH logical channel, Stage 2 and Stage 3 are not applied. It uses Reed Muller block code in Stage 1 and scrambling in Stage 4.
Which error control stages are applied to TCH/7,2 and TCH-P8/10,8 logical channels?
Only Stage 4 (scrambling) is applied. The other stages are not applied.
Which error control scheme is used for logical channels carrying on the payload section of QAM channels, such as SCH-Q/HU and BNCH-Q?

Logical channels carrying on the payload section of QAM channels use a concatenation of CRC encoding, PCCC turbo encoding, interleaving, and scrambling. In certain cases, the PCCC encoding stage may be omitted, which is referred to as the unencoded case.
How are timing and frequency synchronization errors modeled statistically?

Timing and frequency synchronization errors are assumed to be zero-mean uncorrelated Gaussian random variables with various normalized standard deviations, denoted as $\sigma_{\tau} / T$ and $\sigma_{\nu} / T$, respectively.
Under what conditions should SNDCP instruct layer 2 to use the extended error control Frame Check Sequence?

SNDCP should instruct layer 2 to use the extended error control Frame Check Sequence when transmitting a background class data packet or when transmitting a telemetry class data packet that requires high reliability.
How does the MAC handle a basic link message that exceeds the size of a single MAC transmission unit, and what happens if a fragment error occurs?

The MAC performs fragmentation, subdividing the TM-SDU (including the LLC header) into two or more fragments, each sent in one MAC PDU within one MAC block. Since fragments are not numbered, they must be sent in sequence. If an error occurs during the transmission of any fragment, the recipient cannot reconstruct the message, the MAC procedure fails, and the LLC must re-send the whole message.
How does the advanced link handle error control?
It uses extended error control using a Frame Check Sequence (FCS), which is calculated over the entire TL-SDU.
What action is taken if an error is detected in a re-assembled TL-SDU by the LLC's Frame Check Sequence during point-to-point transfer?
The receiving LLC requests a complete retransmission of the TL-SDU.
How does the MAC adjust bit rate based on slot error rate relative to the target range?

If the slot error rate exceeds the maximum acceptable, a lower bit rate is chosen to achieve more reliability. If the slot error rate is less than the minimum in the target range, a higher bit rate is chosen to achieve higher throughput.
What is the relationship between reliability levels and slot error rates for background class data?

For background class data, reliability level 1 allows relatively high slot error rates to enable higher bit rates and throughput. Reliability level 2 applies more moderate slot error rates. Reliability level 3 applies lower slot error rates, used when the maximum number of segment retransmissions may soon be exceeded.
What type of slot error rate algorithm is expected for real-time class data?
The MAC is expected to use an algorithm with relatively low slot error rates for real-time class data.
How is the RMS vector error (RMSVE) computed from the Sum Square Vector Error (SSVE)?
The RMS vector error is computed as the square root of the sum-square vector error divided by the number of symbols in the burst (SNmax).
What aspects of transmitter quality does the vector error magnitude measure account for in QAM modulation?

Vector error magnitude accounts for modulation filtering linear distortion (amplitude and phase), inter-subcarrier spectral overlap, modulator impairments (quadrature offset, phase and linear amplitude errors), local oscillator phase noise, filter distortion, and non-linearity of amplifiers.
Under what power level conditions must TETRA QAM equipment fulfill the vector error magnitude requirement?
The requirement must be fulfilled over all sub-carriers with both maximum and minimum power levels.
How should the receiver be connected to the transmitter when measuring vector error magnitude, and why?
The receiver must be back-to-back connected to the transmitter to avoid channel impairments such as distortion, noise, and interference.
What assumption is made about the receiver behavior during the vector error magnitude measurement?
It is assumed that the receiver has ideal behaviour, a condition that can be closely approximated in the lab.
How is the Root-Mean-Square Vector Error (RMSVE) calculated over all burst symbols?

RMSVE is calculated as the square root of the sum of the squared magnitudes of the error terms $E_{m}(k)$ for all subcarriers and symbols, divided by the total number of subcarriers ($M$) multiplied by the number of symbols per subcarrier ($L$).
How many receiver classes has the TETRA standard defined based on intended operating environments and test conditions?
Four receiver classes have been defined.
Under what conditions must the wanted input signal level and interference signal be set for co-channel interference testing?

For co-channel interference testing, the wanted input signal level must be -85 dBm above the dynamic reference sensitivity level, and the interference signal must be a continuous TETRA random signal with the same modulation and propagation condition as the wanted signal, but independently realized.
What are the signal level requirements for the wanted QAM signal and the interfering TETRA signal in the specified test configuration?

The wanted QAM signal must have a level 3 dB above the static reference sensitivity level. The interfering signal is a TETRA π/4-DQPSK random modulated continuous signal at a frequency offset f0 from the useful signal, with its level defined in table 8.21.
What specific assumptions are made in Appendix C regarding channel knowledge to analyze the impact of channel estimation errors on receiver MER?
Appendix C presents results obtained under the assumption of either exact channel knowledge (error-free channel estimation) or exact knowledge of MS velocity for the Bayesian channel estimator.
Under what propagation conditions is receiver dynamic sensitivity obtained, and what Frame Error Rate does it comply with?
Receiver dynamic sensitivity is obtained under typical urban TU50 propagation conditions to comply with a message Frame Error Rate (FER) of 10 %.
How is the Message Error Rate (MER) metric defined in terms of bit errors within a message?
A message, which constitutes the entire data content of a time slot, is considered in error if a single bit is detected erroneously.
Which performance ratios are used to measure the Message Error Rate (MER) for noise-limited and interference-limited scenarios respectively?

MER is measured versus the mean-bit-energy-to-spectral-noise-density ratio ($\frac{E_b}{N_0}$) for noise-limited performance, or versus the signal-to-interference ratio (SIR) for interference-limited performance.
在主从复制中跳过错误的主要目的是什么？
跳过主从复制中遇到的所有错误或指定类型的错误，避免 slave 端复制中断。
主从复制中的 1062 错误和 1032 错误分别是由什么原因引起的？
1062 错误是指一些主键重复，1032 错误是因为主从数据库数据不一致。
MDM SE 系统设置中 MDM Pro IP 地址与端口填写错误时，应如何处理？
若 MDM Pro IP 地址与端口填写错误，请登录 MDM Pro 确认正确的 IP 地址与端口，然后重新注册。
公文下载过程中遇到网络故障或关机时，任务会如何处理？
未完成下载的任务停止下载，网络恢复正常或开机后，重新自动下载。
如果设备无法使用相机，应如何排查和处理？
若未检测到前置或后置摄像头，请关机后开机重试；若因内存不足导致，请清理内存。
当终端遇到异常（如被 ROOT）时，如何进行自我处理？
终端侧可调用内置围栏策略进行自我处理。
维修后的终端若需达到等同原机的防护级别，必须执行什么测试？对维修站有何要求？
必须进行整机气密性防水测试。只有经我司授权维修站维修的产品，才可以保证等同原机的防护级别；经销商需派技术人员参加培训并经考试合格获得授权维修证书。
使用万用表测试天线弹片对地阻抗时，正常值是多少？有哪些异常情况需要避免？
正常阻抗为 10kΩ 左右，不得短路或断路。
当检测到时钟信号18.432MHz异常时，应检查哪些器件？
当时钟信号18.432MHz异常时，应检查U6200及周边器件。
若射频前端输出不正常，故障排查的最后一步涉及检查哪些部分？
若射频前端输出不正常，应检查U6305及整个射频前端电路。
进行所有测试时，接收省电功能需要处于什么状态？
接收省电关闭
什么情况下 VCO 会导致收发异常？
当 VCO 反馈给 AK2404 的幅度低于芯片引脚要求时，会导致收发异常。
整机耦合测试中，若 LTE 分集接收灵敏度结果异常，应检查什么？
应检查 LTE 分集天线本体以及弹片接触是否正常。
进行综合测试时，推荐的电源规格和专用测试工具包括哪些？
电源需使用电池盒或大于 3A/10V 的直流稳压电源；专用测试工具包括 BNC 射频头、射频转接头、大于 500MHz 示波器及高频探头。
如何校准低频频偏至 4.95kHz ± 0.05kHz？
选择 AT+DMOSETMOD2GAIN=0,20000。其中 0 对应校准的频率，若校准 410M 则改为 1。
What should be done if the radio keys do not work due to failure to function?
Restart the radio.
在电子地图功能测试中，包含哪些具体的显示和查询项目？
电子地图功能测试包含进入电子地图、按组织查询终端、多模终端显示、宽带终端显示、场强热力显示、位置热力显示、搜索以及切换地图类型。
管控模式相关的测试项包括哪些操作？
管控模式相关的测试项包括打开自升级管控模式、关闭自升级管控模式、打开强管控模式以及关闭强管控模式。
若客户无标准功能需求，应如何进行 FAT 测试？
可按照验收测试功能表单逐条进行 FAT 测试。
How can a user verify if the equipment is causing harmful interference to radio or television reception?
Verification can be determined by turning the equipment off and then on.
What compliance has the device been tested for regarding SAR limits?
The device has been tested and complies with SAR limits.
Under which FCC rules was the equipment tested for compliance as a Class B digital device?
The equipment was tested and found to comply with the limits for a Class B digital device pursuant to part 15 of FCC Rules.
在指定WLAN配置下，无线上传的连接失败处理机制是怎样的？
在指定WLAN情况下，如果连接DEM失败，终端会一直尝试连接直至成功。在此模式下，不允许使用4G进行连接。
当时间间隔小于2小时的无线上传触发连接失败时，系统如何处理？
如果时间间隔小于2小时上传，在第一次连接失败后，系统不进行连接失败处理。
In the provided log output, what are the reported values for errors and replies from the rcli container?
errors: 0, replies: 4730093
进行PDC760测试准备时，需要准备几台设备以及各自的用途是什么？
需要准备两台PDC760，一台用于测试，另一台用于对比。
在开始测试前，两台PDC760需要满足什么接入条件？
两台PDC760均需接入PUC（Professional United Communications，专业统一通信平台）。
在 PPS 测试中，评判 PPS 是否生效的具体标准是什么？
测试机全程无明显偏移、断续，精度误差在 10 米以内；对比机有明显偏移或断续，精度误差大于 10 米。
进行 PPS 定位效果测试时，测试环境和时长有哪些具体要求？
需携带测试机和对比机在高楼间穿行，经过多个无 GPS 信号的点位，总测试时长为 30 分钟。
PPS 测试方法适用于哪些具体的室内外场景？
适用于火车站、商超、居民楼、街道、隧道、大型体育馆、地下车库、公路、铁路等多种室内外场景。
Under which FCC rules was this equipment tested for compliance?
This equipment was tested and found to comply with the limits for a Class B digital device, pursuant to part 15 of FCC Rules.
在故障复现场景中，当基站指定使用SCK subset number=2和SCK14时，Hytera终端实际获取了哪个SCK，导致呼叫失败的原因是什么？
终端实际获取了SCK4。原因是终端在利用SCK subset number定位具体SCK时，仅使用默认值subset number=1，从而从KAG5中取到第一个SCK即SCK4；由于终端数据库中只有SCK14，SCK4不存在于列表中，导致不能正确发起加密呼叫。
How can you verify that the radio is successfully connected to the MDM Pro?
If "Connected" is displayed, the radio is connected to the MDM Pro.
切组失败是否纳入本需求的考虑范围？
不纳入。切组失败属于已有业务的异常情形，依原有逻辑处理。
当MDM端因模式切换导致导入失败而重新操作批量导入时，下发数据的去重机制是怎样的？
MDM会对导入数据进行去重，下发的数据不包含之前传输成功的联系人数据。
维修终端后，若用户要求达到等同原机的防护级别，必须执行什么测试？
必须进行整机气密性防水测试。
如果经销商没有防水测试条件，但用户需要等同原机的防护级别，应如何处理？
请寄回我司维修或请我司协调就近授权维修站处理。
使用万用表测试天线弹片对地阻抗时，正常值是多少？有哪些异常情况需要排除？
正常阻抗为 10kΩ 左右，不得出现短路或断路情况。
如果Q6300静态工作点异常，下一步应如何操作？
应检查Q6300。
进行相关测试时对接收省电模式有什么要求？
需在接收省电关闭的情况下测试。
CAT4 模块输出的信号类型有哪些，校准测试应如何操作？
CAT4 模块输出 2/3/4G & WiFi/BT 信号，校准测试需检测模块至对应射频链路。
在屏蔽环境下测试接收灵敏度时有什么要求？
在屏蔽环境下测试接收灵敏度时，需确保相应仪器和工具正常。
进行综合测试时，推荐的电源规格要求是什么？
电池盒，或大于 3A / 10V 的直流稳压电源。
在直通与SFR转发同频2时隙信号优选场景中，若强制选择语音质量更好的信号接入，会出现什么故障现象？
可能会出现掉字或重复音情况。
What is the latest version for Smart MDM Professional and Smart MDM Lite?
The latest version for both Smart MDM Professional and Smart MDM Lite is V2.7.05.000.
What are the initial and latest versions for the Multi-mode device model PDC760 with initial version V1.0.001A?
For the Multi-mode device model PDC760 with initial version V1.0.001A, the latest version is V2.6.002101.
What is the latest version for the LTE Radio device model PNC550 in the Republic of Korea?
The latest version for the LTE Radio device model PNC550 in the Republic of Korea is V1.0.12.001.01.
如果尝试重新写频仍然失败，应采取什么措施？
请联系海能达客服。
What are the latest versions for the Multi-mode devices PDC760 and PTC760?
The latest version for the Multi-mode device PDC760 is V3.5.001101, and for PTC760 it is V3.5.00101.
Which DMR Radio models have a latest version of V9.00.06.001?
The DMR Radio models with a latest version of V9.00.06.001 are PD680, PD700, PD750, and PD780.
What is the requirement for Group ID and ISSI values to prevent group call failures?
The values of Group ID and ISSI must be different. If they are the same, group calls may fail.
How does the Smart MDM verify a device's identity during connection?
The Smart MDM compares the device IMEI and license keys stored in it with those sent by the device. The connection is allowed only when the comparison results are consistent.
ePDT通信系统设备的介电强度试验中，试验电压、持续时间及合格标准是什么？

The binary code 110₂ indicates that the position error is more than 200 km.

频偏校准的目的是使调制器为每个调制符号提供正确的载波相位偏移。

若未接收到响应，或者检测到非预期的本系统的活动（如与原有业务无关的活动），则重试过程失败。

Tap the screen to view 12 images in order and check whether any defect pixel exists. If no defect pixels are found, tap PASS; otherwise, tap FAIL.
How do you determine if the Backlight test passes or fails?
Check whether the main screen turns dark and light in turn. If it does, tap PASS; otherwise, tap FAIL. The normal sequence is normal->dark->bright->dark->bright.
What steps must be followed to complete the Key test?
Press each key shown on the screen and check whether the corresponding button turns green when the key is being pressed. If all buttons turn green, tap PASS; otherwise, tap FAIL.
How do you perform the touchscreen test and determine the result?
Draw lines with your finger on the grey areas in order. If all the lines drawn are complete, tap PASS; otherwise, tap FAIL.
What is the procedure for testing motor vibration levels?
Tap the buttons to test each level of motor vibration. If the motor vibrates normally, tap PASS; otherwise, tap FAIL.
Describe the steps to test the Top Mic during the sound test.
Tap Top Mic, speak into the top microphone for four seconds, and then listen to the recorded audio.
How do you verify the light sensor is functioning correctly?
Cover the light sensor with your hand and then remove your hand. If the light intensity decreases when you cover the sensor, and increases when you remove your hand, tap PASS; otherwise, tap FAIL.
How do you test the gravity sensor and determine if it passes?
Shake the radio and check whether the values of X, Y, and Z change. If the values change, tap PASS; otherwise, tap FAIL.
What are the steps to test the front and back cameras?
First, tap front cam. If the camera takes photos and records videos properly, tap PASS; otherwise, tap FAIL. Then, tap back cam, and repeat the same check.
How is the LED indicator test performed and evaluated?
Tap Led auto test and check whether the two LED indicators flash or glow red, green, orange, and blue in order. If the two indicators flash or glow properly, tap PASS; otherwise, tap FAIL.
What is the procedure for testing NFC functionality?
Hold the radio with its back near an NFC tag. If the radio emits an alert tone and displays the information of the NFC tag, tap PASS; otherwise, tap FAIL.
How do you test the gyroscope function on the radio?
Shake the radio and check whether the values of X, Y, and Z change. If the values change, tap PASS; otherwise, tap FAIL.
What is the procedure for calibrating and testing the compass?

Hold the radio and make a figure 8 pattern in the air until the accuracy value at the top of the screen turns "3(OK)". If the magnetic needle correctly shows the directions, tap PASS; otherwise, tap FAIL.
How is the flash light tested?
Tap FlashLight. If the flash turns on, tap PASS; otherwise, tap FAIL.

Green indicates that the item passes the test. Red indicates that the item fails to pass the test.
